title: French Onion Baked Chicken
ingredients: 1-1.5 cups seasoned croutons, crushed into coarse crumbs
instructions: Pour the French onion soup evenly into the bottom of the baking dish. Season the chicken breasts with salt, pepper and garlic powder and add them side-by-side to the baking dish.
Spread the French onion dip evenly over the top of the chicken.
Crush the seasoned croutons and toss them with 2-3 tablespoons melted butter. Sprinkle the buttery crouton mixture over the chicken.
Add the slices of provolone cheese over the top. Cover the casserole dish with foil and bake for about 30 minutes.

Remove the foil and continue baking for another 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and golden and the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F. Let the chicken rest for about 5 minutes, garnish with parsley then serve with the creamy French onion sauce spooned over the top.
notes: Pro tips from the source: pound thick chicken breasts for even cooking; go easy on added salt since the soup, dip, cheese and croutons are already salty; don't crush croutons into a fine powder — leave larger pieces for crunch; broil for a minute or two at the end for extra golden color; spoon the French onion sauce from the bottom of the dish over the chicken when serving. Can be assembled ahead and refrigerated, but add croutons and cheese right before baking. Leftovers keep 3-4 days refrigerated. Variations: swap provolone for Swiss, Gruyère, or mozzarella; add sautéed/caramelized onions under the cheese; mix Parmesan into the crouton topping; substitute boneless skinless chicken thighs.
